<!-- Thank you for your contribution! Please follow these guidelines to enhance your pull request. If anything is unclear, submit your PR and reach out to maintainers for assistance. Join our Slack community at https://slack.sglang.io to discuss further. -->

## Motivation

<!-- Describe the purpose and goals of this pull request. -->

pplx-kernels a2a is a symmetric collective, meaning every EP rank must dispatch the same number of tokens. Otherwise, the device-side handshake deadlocks (idle DP ranks with 0 tokens never signal their peers). We must therefore force MAX_LEN so all ranks are padded to equal token counts.

TopKRouter assigns `topk_ids = -1` for padded tokens. Unlike DeepEP, pplx-kernels has no skip for topk_ids = -1. When passing `topk_ids.to(torch.uint32)`, -1 becomes 2^32 - 1, leading to **CUDA illegal memory access**.

## Modifications

<!-- Detail the changes made in this pull request. -->

Pass the number of real tokens on each rank to `bound_m`. Now, only real tokens involve in a2a communication and MoE runner. Padded tokens never involve.

## Accuracy Tests

<!-- If this pull request affects model outputs (e.g., changes to the kernel or model forward code), provide accuracy test results. -->

```
SGLANG_PPLX_NUM_MAX_DISPATCH_TOKENS_PER_RANK=512 \
python -m sglang.launch_server --model-path Qwen/Qwen3-30B-A3B --trust-remote-code \
  --tp 2 --dp 2 --enable-dp-attention --enable-dp-lm-head \
  --moe-a2a-backend pplx --deepep-mode low_latency --moe-runner-backend deep_gemm \
  --mem-fraction-static 0.85 --max-running-requests 1024 --stream-interval 5 \
  --disable-radix-cache --cuda-graph-bs-decode 1 2 4 8 16 32 64 128 256 512 \
  --chunked-prefill-size 512 --skip-server-warmup --watchdog-timeout 600 --port 30146

python -m sglang.test.few_shot_gsm8k --num-shots 5 --num-questions 200 --parallel 1024 --port 30146

Accuracy: 0.925
Invalid: 0.000
Latency: 35.691 s
Output throughput: 626.719 token/s
```

@@ -187,6 +187,19 @@ def get_all_to_all(
         return cls._all_to_all
 
 
+def _pplx_routing(
+    topk_ids: torch.Tensor, topk_weights: torch.Tensor
+) -> Tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    invalid = topk_ids < 0
+    bound_m = (~invalid).any(dim=1).sum().to(torch.uint32).reshape(1)
+    fill = torch.arange(
+        topk_ids.shape[1], device=topk_ids.device, dtype=topk_ids.dtype
+    ).expand_as(topk_ids)
+    indices = torch.where(invalid, fill, topk_ids).to(torch.uint32)
+    weights = topk_weights.masked_fill(invalid, 0.0).to(torch.float32)
+    return indices, weights, bound_m
+
+
 class _PplxDispatcherImpl:
     def __init__(
         self,
@@ -316,8 +329,7 @@ def dispatch_a(
                 device=device,
             )
 
-        bound_m = torch.full((1,), num_tokens, dtype=torch.uint32, device=device)
-        indices = topk_ids.to(torch.uint32)
